description: Read the active ui.layout@1 one person made for a product's own surface, with that surface's device class. A first-party service presents a service token for openvibe.network and names the person with X-OV-Subject (which must be the person in the path); it reads one layout and nothing else of their account, and never their saved or gallery layouts. The person's own token uses GET /api/v1/me/layouts/:surface instead, which reads and writes only their own rows.
